'''Shepherd's shears''' are shears with Looting III, sold by the [[Shepherd|shepherd]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 2 shepherd sells them for 3 [[Obol|obols]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/2/shepherds_shears.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
They have 3000 durability and are repaired with blocks of copper. Looting works on shears in Matcha Flavoured: each Looting level adds up to 3 extra wool per stack when shearing sheep. See [[Shears]].
